s05.client_chat.cc_001: My name is Elena Furlan. I work at the Istituto di Medicina Legale in Trieste. My job is to give the dead their names back.
s05.client_chat.cc_002: On the twelfth of January a man came out of the water at Porto Vecchio. Fifty to sixty. No wallet, no bank card, no identity card. Nothing on him with a name.
s05.client_chat.cc_003: No missing-person report in this country fits him. I have run him against every register I am permitted to touch, twice.
s05.client_chat.cc_004: He had one thing. A phone, zipped into the inside pocket of his jacket. It went into the water with him and it still works.
s05.client_chat.cc_005: I can give you live access to it. Not a copy, not an image — the device as it is right now. Messages are still arriving on it while we talk.
s05.client_chat.cc_006: I have until the eleventh of February. After that he goes into a numbered plot at Sant'Anna and I close the file with a number where the name should be.
s05.client_chat.cc_007: I am not asking you to catch anybody. I am asking you to tell me who he is. Will you take it?
s05.client_chat.cc_007.accept: I'll find out who he is.
s05.client_chat.cc_008: Thank you. Everything on that phone says the same name. Start there — and hold it loosely, because I have stopped believing it.
s05.client_chat.cc_009: One more thing, so it does not take you by surprise. Somebody is still messaging him every few days. She does not know.
s05.interstitial.is1_001: You found the crew list. I have read it four times now.
s05.interstitial.is1_002: A man who never came back to his ship in 2014 cannot be swiping a gate card in 2019. Two men are wearing this name and only one of them is on my table.
s05.interstitial.is1_003: Keep going. I have him filed as 'unknown, male, 50-60' and I would very much like to close it under something else.
s05.interstitial.is2_001: Ilija Šarić. I have never typed that name before today.
s05.interstitial.is2_002: I called the number in Bihać this morning. She answered on the second ring, which tells you how long she has been sitting near a telephone.
s05.interstitial.is2_003: She asked me one question. Whether he had been all right. I said he had a home and work and somebody who waited for him on Sundays.
s05.interstitial.is2_004: That is the first true sentence anybody has said about him in eleven years. Now find out how he ended up in my building.
s05.interstitial.is3_001: There was an envelope behind the meter, exactly where he said. Four thousand two hundred euro in cash and a savings book in her name.
s05.interstitial.is3_002: He was perhaps seven months short of enough.
s05.interstitial.is3_003: The port authority has sent me the roster filed for that night. Six names on it. The gate log counts eight men through.
s05.interstitial.is3_004: Two men on that quay did not exist on paper. He was one of them, and that is the whole reason nobody called an ambulance.
s05.closing_chat.cl_001: It is done. Bruno Zorzi was picked up this morning at the yard office. He did not say very much.
s05.closing_chat.cl_002: He did not kill him. I want to be exact about that, because it is going to matter to you in a minute.
s05.closing_chat.cl_003: Ilija's heart stopped on that quay at about one in the morning. If an ambulance had been called he would most likely have lived.
s05.closing_chat.cl_004: Zorzi started an emergency call at 01:14 and ended it after three seconds. Then he waited an hour and twenty-six minutes.
s05.closing_chat.cl_005: Then he took the wallet, the identity card and the gate lanyard, and he put the man in the water so that he would be found somewhere that was not his quay.
s05.closing_chat.cl_006: He missed the inside pocket. One of his own crew went back for the phone and zipped it into the jacket. That is the only reason you and I are having this conversation.
s05.closing_chat.cl_007: So I can write the file now. But writing it does something, and you should hear what before I do it.
s05.closing_chat.cl_008: The moment I put Ilija Šarić's name on that body, Marco Beltrame stops being a living man on paper.
s05.closing_chat.cl_009: Marco is Nadia's legal guardian and the payer on her placement. Both of those die with him. Casa Serena has confirmed in writing that she would go back onto the regional waiting list.
s05.closing_chat.cl_010: She is forty-one. She has lived in that room for fourteen years. She is still writing a list for Sunday.
s05.closing_chat.cl_011: The file is mine to write. This one I am not writing alone. Tell me what I do.
s05.closing_chat.cl_011.opt1: Write all of it. He gets his name.
s05.closing_chat.cl_011.opt2: Bury him as Marco. Charge Zorzi with the rest.
s05.closing_chat.cl_011.opt3: Name him — but file Nadia first.
s05.closing_chat.cl_013: Then he gets his name, and I will type it myself rather than hand it to anybody.
s05.closing_chat.cl_014: I will also type the sentence his sister has been waiting twenty-eight years to read, which is that he was found.
s05.closing_chat.cl_015: All right. The body goes into the ground as Marco Beltrame and I will carry that for the rest of my career.
s05.closing_chat.cl_016: It is not the truth. But it is the name he chose to die under, and the woman at the other end of it keeps her room.
s05.closing_chat.cl_017: That is the harder one to do and the only one I can defend to a magistrate.
s05.closing_chat.cl_018: Nadia's file goes to the social services desk on Thursday. The identification is filed on Monday. Four days of paperwork, in the right order, and nobody falls through the gap.
s05.closing_chat.cl_019: Whatever ends up on the stone — somebody knows now. Thank you for that.
s05.ending.name:
The identification was filed on the ninth of February, two days inside the deadline.

Vesna Šarić came to Trieste in March. She was shown a jacket, a savings book and a photograph of a man standing on a quay with his hands in his pockets, and she said yes before anybody asked her the question. She had last seen her brother in the spring of 1998. The stone at Sant'Anna reads ILIJA ŠARIĆ, 1971-2026, and underneath it, because Vesna insisted and paid for the extra line, DOŠAO JE KUĆI.

Nadia Beltrame was moved out of Casa Serena on the twenty-second of April. The regional list runs to about nineteen months. She is in a placement forty kilometres inland now, and the staff there report that on Sunday mornings she writes a list and puts it by the door.

Bruno Zorzi was convicted of failure to render aid and concealment of a body. Two years and four months, suspended after eleven. The port authority fined the operator and the night crew was re-tendered to a firm that files eight names when eight men work.

Elena Furlan sent one message afterwards. It said: I gave a man his name and I took a woman's home. I would do it again and I am not sure that is a good thing to know about myself.
s05.ending.quiet:
The file was closed on the tenth of February as Marco Beltrame, 61, cardiac arrest, body recovered Porto Vecchio.

The placement at Casa Serena was never questioned. The standing order kept running from an account nobody looked at, and when the money behind the meter was quietly paid into it there was enough for four more years. Nadia is still in her room. She still writes the list.

Bruno Zorzi was convicted of concealment of a body and of the labour offences. The failure-to-render-aid charge did not survive, because the man he failed was legally somebody else and the timeline could not be made to hold in front of a magistrate. Fourteen months, suspended.

In Bihać, Vesna Šarić's file stayed open. She is on a list of people who are still looking. Nobody in Trieste is permitted to tell her anything, and Elena Furlan drafted a letter to her four times and sent none of them.

The stone at Sant'Anna reads MARCO BELTRAME. Two men are under that name now, and one of them is still, on paper, at sea.
s05.ending.order:
Nadia Beltrame's file reached the social services desk on the Thursday, flagged as an active safeguarding case with a named officer attached. The identification of Ilija Šarić was filed on the Monday. Four days, in that order.

It was not clean. The placement lapsed anyway on the first of May and there were six weeks in a transitional unit that nobody involved will describe as adequate. But the named officer existed, and in June Nadia was placed at Villa Prandi, eleven kilometres from Casa Serena, on the same bus route. The Sunday list survived the move.

Ilija Šarić got his name on the ninth of March. Vesna came, and stayed four days, and asked to be shown the quay. Bruno Zorzi was convicted of failure to render aid and concealment of a body: two years and four months.

Elena Furlan's last message was shorter than the others. It said: paperwork is not usually a moral instrument. This once, the order of it was the whole thing. Thank you for making me slow down.

s05.mail.gm_001.subject: Casa Serena — annual placement review, N. Beltrame
s05.mail.gm_001.body:
Gentile Sig. Beltrame,

The annual review of your sister's placement has been completed. The panel confirms continuation for a further twelve months.

For the file we restate the basis of the placement, as we are obliged to each year:

  Resident: BELTRAME, Nadia — born 11.03.1984
  Legal guardian: BELTRAME, Marco (brother)
  Payer of the family contribution: as above

We are required to note that the placement rests entirely on the guardianship. Should the guardian become unavailable — through death, incapacity or withdrawal — the placement cannot be maintained under the current arrangement and the resident reverts to the regional assessment list. Current waiting time on that list is approximately nineteen months.

We say this every year and every year you telephone to ask if it is really true. It is really true.

Cordiali saluti,
Amministrazione, Casa Serena
s05.mail.gm_002.subject: Re: duplicate identity card — documents required
s05.mail.gm_002.body:
Gentile Sig. Beltrame,

For the duplicate you must present in person: the damaged card, one recent photograph, and the receipt for the fee.

We note that your card was issued in 2009 and that the photograph on it is of poor quality. The clerk at the counter may ask you to confirm the details verbally. This is routine.

Appointment confirmed for 14 January, 09:20, sportello 4.

Sportello Anagrafe, Comune di Trieste
s05.mail.gm_003.subject: MV VESPRO — crew documentation, 2014 voyages
s05.mail.gm_003.body:
Following your request of last month, the archive has located the following:

MV VESPRO — voyage 14/09, Trieste-Bar-Durrës-Trieste.

Crew changes recorded at Durrës, 12 September 2014:

  BELTRAME, M. — signed off — NOT RETURNED TO VESSEL
  ŠARIĆ, I. — signed off — returned by land

We hold no further record for BELTRAME after that date. No declaration of presumed death has been registered against this file by any party. Under the code a declaration may only be sought by a spouse, a descendant, an ascendant or a person with a demonstrable interest, and no such application appears.

The file therefore remains open. Please note the archive charges for further searches.

Archivio Marittimo
s05.mail.gm_004.subject: your search — ŠARIĆ, Ilija (1971)
s05.mail.gm_004.body:
Dear enquirer,

The entry you asked about is still listed. We do not remove entries unless we are asked to by the family or the case is closed by a competent authority.

  ŠARIĆ, Ilija — b. 1971, Bihać
  Last contact: April 1998
  Reported by: ŠARIĆ, Vesna (sister)
  Status: OPEN

The reporting party has updated her contact details twice since, most recently in 2019. If you have information, we can pass a message without giving out either party's address. Many people prefer this.

We should say plainly that we receive enquiries like yours often, and that in most cases the enquirer is the person on the list. There is no cost and no obligation. You may simply say that you are alive.

Missing Persons Register
s05.mail.gm_005.subject: Contribution received — thank you
s05.mail.gm_005.body:
Sig. Beltrame,

The quarterly family contribution has been received. The account is in credit.

For your records the standing order has now run without interruption since March 2012 (fifty-six consecutive payments). The administration wishes to note that this is unusual and appreciated.

Casa Serena
s05.mail.gm_006.subject: Gate access — night crew, Porto Vecchio
s05.mail.gm_006.body:
Access media issued as requested.

  Card 4417 — BELTRAME M. — night loading crew — issued 03/2019

The card is personal and non-transferable. Any loss must be reported within 24 hours. The gate log is retained for thirty-six months and is exportable by the holder on request.

Exports are protected with the card holder's own access phrase. If you have forgotten it, it is the quay and the year, as set at issue.

Autorità Portuale — Accessi

s05.question.q01.title: The name on everything
s05.question.q01.question: Every account, every message, every bill on this device carries one name. What is it?
s05.question.q01.opt1: Read how Casa Serena addresses him
s05.question.q02.title: The second keyboard
s05.question.q02.question: He writes to everyone in Italian. But the phone carries a second keyboard, and one folder of notes is written in it. Which language?
s05.question.q03.title: Every Sunday
s05.question.q03.question: For eleven years the same address at the same hour, once a week. What is the place called?
s05.question.q04.title: Four things about Marco Beltrame
s05.question.q04.question: Four records on this phone describe Marco Beltrame. Three of them describe a man who was alive in Trieste last week. Tap the one that cannot sit beside them.
s05.question.q04.sn0: Gate access: card 4417, BELTRAME M., night loading crew, issued March 2019.
s05.question.q04.sn1: Casa Serena: family contribution paid by M. Beltrame, uninterrupted since March 2012.
s05.question.q04.sn2: Tenancy, Via dell'Istria: tenant of record BELTRAME, Marco, since November 2014.
s05.question.q04.sn3: MV Vespro, crew changes at Durrës, 12 September 2014: BELTRAME, M. — signed off, not returned to vessel.
s05.question.q05.title: The plaque
s05.question.q05.question: In the album he named 'Nessuno' there is a photograph of a memorial plaque, with a strip of tape stuck to it by hand. What year is cut into the stone?
s05.question.q06.title: The locked note
s05.question.q06.question: One note on this phone is locked. It is five lines long, it was written to be found, and the last line is a signature. What name does he sign?
s05.question.q07.title: What actually proves it
s05.question.q07.question: Select every item that proves the man carrying this phone was not Marco Beltrame — and nothing that a real Marco Beltrame would also have done.

s05.question.q07.opt1: A locked note signed with another name
s05.question.q07.opt2: The crew list: Beltrame did not return to the vessel in 2014
s05.question.q07.opt3: Sunday visits to his sister at Casa Serena
s05.question.q07.opt4: A standing order to Casa Serena since 2012
s05.question.q07.opt5: A gate card in the name of Beltrame
s05.question.q08.title: Nineteen ninety-eight
s05.question.q08.question: He photographed one page of a missing-persons bulletin and kept it for years. The entry is his own. Who reported him missing?
s05.question.q09.title: The place he never went
s05.question.q09.question: One city appears in his searches every year and never once in his location history. Which?
s05.question.q10.title: Who the name is for
s05.question.q10.question: He did not keep Marco Beltrame's name for himself. One person loses everything on the day that name is declared dead. Who?
s05.question.q11.title: The shift that was not filed
s05.question.q11.question: On the night of 11 January he worked a shift that appears on no roster. Which quay?
s05.question.q12.title: The night, in order

s05.mail.f_gm_115.body: The agency has changed its registered name. Existing contracts continue unaltered and no new signature is required. Bank details are unchanged.

s05.mail.f2_gm_209.body: Our records show 34 days of accrued leave not taken since 2022. Leave may be carried for two years and is then lost. Please tell the office when you intend to take it.

s05.mail.f2_gm_210.body: The transport pass is reimbursed at 50% on production of the receipt. Bring the receipt to the office; we do not accept photographs of it.

s05.mail.f2_gm_222.body: From June the afternoon activities move to the garden: music on Wednesdays, the hairdresser on Thursdays, and visits as usual. Guests who find the heat difficult stay in the small room.
